verdict.rationale: An MCP registry and hosting platform could plausibly ship an official publish-and-deploy CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes web and GitHub-driven flows: connecting a repo so Glama builds the image, deploying from the registry, and copy-pasting config blocks into clients. mcp-proxy is mentioned only as a tunnel for testing local servers, and nothing shows a CLI for authenticating, building, pushing, or installing servers into agents.
